templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from phase-lanes by the note-writer: this is a plain top-down layered software stack (interfaces, compiler, runtime, OS/drivers) with zero drawn flows and a small mirrored remote-runtime box; there is no time axis, no lane gutter, nothing resembling a phase.
templates.what_to_learn: Treat this as a layered template figure instead: stack the five tiers top-down, each one depending only on the one below, and echo the same fill color on the small remote-runtime box to show it is a copy of the local runtime tier, not a different component.
